name: Buddh International Circuit
notes: Buddh International Circuit (clockwise). Raceway loop. Traced 5069 m vs 5125 m. Start line in the middle of the pit straight. Two DRS zones as in 2012: the back straight from Turn 3 to Turn 4 and the pit straight. Values from 2012 F1: race laps, pit lane loss and overtaking are approximate. tyre_wear_mult and the wet weather multiplier are first guesses and will be tuned. speed_scale is 1.0 until the lap time calibration against the 2012 pole. pole_side is the inside of the first corner (approximate).
